tools.name: mandate.check
tools.title: Check a program
tools.description: Validates a Mandate program (text or IR), resolves names and runs every static check. Returns ok, the program and definition hashes, and the diagnostics with their codes, facts and repair patches. A program of 0.6 or 0.7 is checked with the libraries its lock pins (`libraries`); the embedded `std.patterns` is found without being given.

source.description: The program: .mdt text or canonical JSON IR.

kind.description: What `source` is. Default: json if it starts with '{', else mdt.

modules.description: Modules the program imports with `use` (e.g. a system model), each as .mdt text or JSON IR. Added to the modules the server was started with (`mandate mcp --module <file>`).

lock.description: The lock file (mandate.lock.json), to check model tiers and W0504.

manifest.description: The text of the library's mandate.library.json.

files.description: Each module file the manifest lists, by its path, with its text.

libraries.description: The libraries the program's lock pins, each as its manifest and its module files. The embedded std.patterns is found without being given.

tools.name: mandate.explain
tools.title: Explain a diagnostic code
tools.description: What a diagnostic code such as MDT-E0320 or E0320 means and how to fix it.

tools.name: mandate.apply_patch
tools.title: Apply an IR patch
tools.description: Applies RFC 6902 operations (add, remove, replace) to a program's canonical IR, against the program hash they were written for. A stale base is refused (MDT-E0130). Returns the new program and hash, its diagnostics, and the governance changes it makes; those need a person's approval. Nothing is saved. A program of 0.6 or 0.7 is checked with its `lock` and the libraries the lock pins (`libraries`), as `check` is, so that the answer says what `check` would say of the patched program.

tools.name: mandate.caps_of
tools.title: Authority of an agent or workflow
tools.description: The paths, hosts, model tiers, commands, repositories, money and external effects an agent or workflow may use, and each of its delegations' grants. A program of 0.6 or 0.7 is checked with its `lock` and the libraries the lock pins (`libraries`), as `check` is.

tools.name: mandate.project
tools.title: A human view of a program
tools.description: A view people review (§15): architecture, authority, cost or attention of a program, the envelope card of one workflow, or the semantic diff from `before` (governance changes, behavior changes, what stayed the same). The card and the attention view are those of a program of 0.7, made from the program and its `lock`; a program that applies a pattern of a pinned library is given that library in `libraries`, as `check` is.

tools.name: mandate.spec
tools.title: The core specification
tools.description: Mandate's core specification (spec/core.md), whole or one numbered section, e.g. 4 for capabilities; or, as the section `patterns` or `attention`, the specification of patterns and libraries (spec/library.md) or of attention (spec/attention.md).
